Renowned for its precision components across multiple sectors, the firm plans to utilize the raised funds to bolster capital expenditures and meet working capital demands.

title: Quote of the day by Irving Fisher: "The chief evils of speculation flow from the participation of the general public, who lack the special knowledge, and enter the market in a purely gambling spirit"
